description: Several buddies, a streak each (issue #237; docs/buddy-streak-design.md, 'Several buddies'). Read by ios/Sources/MorseKitCheck/main.swift and android/app/src/test/java/app/anothermorsetrainer/morsekit/BuddyListTest.kt. Values are written from the rules in the design note and the leaderboard README's v1/v2 status shapes, not captured from either app.

rules.parse: A v2 body has `buddies`; a v1 body has `paired` and at most one `buddy`, which becomes a one-entry list with id "" and maxBuddies 1. A body with neither is not a status (null). An entry without a non-blank displayName is dropped; streaks below zero read as zero; a missing or malformed `today` reads as ""; maxBuddies is at least 1 and at least the list's length.
rules.digest: A buddy counts as practised only when the status is for today (statusDay == today) and it says so. waiting = the rest, in list order. Up to two waiting names are shown; waitingMore counts the others. allPractised needs at least one buddy. bestStreak is the longest streak, 0 with no buddies.
rules.home: No buddies: no line. One buddy: '<name> practised today' or '<name> hasn't practised yet today', then ' · ' and the streak ('N-day buddy streak', or 'no buddy streak yet' at 0). Several: 'All N buddies practised today' or the waiting phrase, then ' · ' and 'best: N-day buddy streak' (or 'no buddy streak yet' when every streak is 0).
rules.waitingPhrase: One: '<a> hasn't practised yet today'. Two: '<a> and <b> haven't practised yet today'. More: '<a>, <b> and <k> more haven't practised yet today'.
rules.reminder: The waiting phrase plus ' (as of <asOf>)', only when the status has been fetched, is for today, and someone is waiting; otherwise none.
rules.keepInvite: An invite this device issued stays shown unless the list is now full (count >= maxBuddies) or a buddy appeared that this device did not join itself. A buddy 'appeared' when no previous entry matches it: same non-empty id, or, when either id is empty (a v1 answer or a cache from before #237), the same name. When this device just joined, the newcomer with the joined id (or, with no id, the first newcomer) is its own and does not count.
